# Pretty Effect

> Small online shop in Adelaide, South Australia, selling hair accessories only: acetate claw clips, satin and velvet bows, silk-blend scrunchies, pearl and enamel slides, padded and knotted headbands. Posted Australia-wide and to New Zealand. No cosmetics, no salon service, no custom pieces, no wholesale.

## Pages
- [Home](https://pretty-effect.com/): the range, facts, FAQ
- [Claw clips](https://pretty-effect.com/claw-clips.html): 5, 8 and 11 cm acetate clips, A$16 to A$28
- [Bows and scrunchies](https://pretty-effect.com/bows-and-scrunchies.html): satin bow A$19, velvet barrette A$24, scrunchie A$14, set of three A$36
- [Slides and headbands](https://pretty-effect.com/slides-and-headbands.html): pearl slide pair A$22, padded headband A$29
- [Checkout](https://pretty-effect.com/checkout.html): order form, confirmed by e-mail with a payment link
- [Our little studio](https://pretty-effect.com/our-little-studio.html)
- [Shipping Australia-wide](https://pretty-effect.com/shipping-australia-wide.html)
- [Change-of-mind returns](https://pretty-effect.com/change-of-mind-returns.html)
